direction_locked: 2026-04-19 — Path 2: keep blue/white futuristic, refs contribute layout/type/motion only (not palette)

colors.note: Two-tone blue (deep navy + signature mid-blue) + ice-blue tint + crisp whites. Ink is near-black for type contrast. Gold reserved for awards/press callouts only. NO warm creams, NO terracotta, NO browns — those belong to the refs, not Frita.

fonts.display: Fraunces (variable serif — editorial with warmth, modern enough for futuristic feel)
fonts.tagline_accent: Caveat or Homemade Apple for Cuban-inspired script flourishes (used sparingly — eyebrow only, never body)
fonts.rule: Inter over Montserrat. Serif display for headlines, sans for UI. NEVER all-sans heavy — kills editorial feel and screams AI-SaaS.

logo.description: FRITA BATIDOS wordmark with flower/pinwheel icon (6-petal). Tagline 'Cuban Inspired Street Food!' in script.
logo.flower_icon_visible_on: counter signage, cups, menu boards, current logo lockup

design_direction.path_chosen: Path 2 — cool-palette editorial (blue/white futuristic) with hospitality-editorial execution from refs
what_to_extract_from_refs: Full-bleed food-as-art hero photography (but cool-grade, not warm)
Editorial restraint — no card boxes, horizontal rules or whitespace between sections
Serif display + clean sans UI type pairing
Confident whitespace — sections breathe, no density
Press/awards as real publication logos with links — not unsourced stars
Smooth motion: parallax scroll on hero, fade-in on reveal, marquee on award strip
what_to_reject_from_refs: Warm palettes (cream, terracotta, wine, sage) — we are blue/white
Heritage/rustic photography treatment — we are cool/modern
British-pub or Mediterranean-villa typography flourishes — we keep flower mark as the only signature ornament
Tablecloth/serviette imagery — Frita is counter-service, picnic benches
brand_dna_must_survive: Shoestring-fries-on-burger signature (the one product photo that must appear)
Chef Eve Aronoff's voice: Slow Food, halal sourcing, Great Lakes dairy, Michigan-first
Awards stack — Michigan Daily Best Burger 2014-2025 consecutive
Communal picnic-bench seating personality (casual chef-driven, not stuffy)
design_direction.futuristic_interpretation: 'Futuristic' = cool-tone + confident whitespace + smooth motion + oversized restrained typography. NOT neon, NOT cyberpunk, NOT Y2K, NOT gradients. Apple-meets-editorial-restaurant.

interior_aesthetic.menu_boards: Blue background with white text (on-brand — palette source of truth)
interior_aesthetic.ceiling: Exposed industrial ductwork, pendant globe lights
interior_aesthetic.counter: Wood top with white base, flower logo decal
interior_aesthetic.details: Net bags of produce hanging on walls, colorful juice dispensers at bar
